Your next

WHATEVER A/S

On behalf of RiskPoint, we are looking for an analytical and data-savvy Product Owner to own their rating engines and portfolio management tooling. If you are as comfortable discussing a pricing factor or a data schema as you are discussing sprint velocity, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies. With more than 325 employees in 18 locations, RiskPoint combines deep underwriting expertise with in-house claims handling and strong business support.

As a Product Owner at RiskPoint, you will become part of a cross-functional global IT-organisation within Finance and Operations, spanning development, architecture, data, infrastructure, and business partnering. RiskPoint is targeting a doubling of the business over the next three years, powered by a digital and AI portfolio built in-house: rating engines on one shared core, AI pipelines that read and route transaction documents, and renewal workbenches redesigned from actual underwriter voice notes. Every new idea is scored through RiskPoint's Portfolio Innovation framework before a line of code gets written.

RiskPoint operates in an agile, collaborative environment with strong cross-border cooperation. Several systems are mid-migration at any given moment, and changes ship across Cyber, Directors and Officers (D&O), Transaction Risk, and Property in parallel. If that sounds chaotic, it is the fun kind. With a flat structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers real impact, ownership, and room to grow.

About the Position:

As a Product Owner for Rating Engines at RiskPoint, you will own the most data-intensive systems in the portfolio: the rating engines that price the risk, and the portfolio management tooling that gives underwriting leadership a real-time view of exposure, concentration, and performance across lines. This is not a roadmap of screens and forms. It is a roadmap of models, calibration logic, and data pipelines.

You will decide what is a Quick Win, what is a Strategic Bet, and what is a Wildcard worth a flutter, with a meaningful share of the ideas coming from data science and actuarial, not just underwriting. You roll out changes through a staged, evidence-led ramp rather than a big bang, and you know when a change touches live pricing and needs a careful hand.

RiskPoint is not hiring to maintain what exists, but to build what doubles the business. That means real ownership, a genuine mandate from leadership, and work that ships in weeks, not quarters, and runs in production rather than gathering dust as a pilot.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

• 
Own the backlog and roadmap for the rating engines, including the shared pricing core, product-specific rating logic, and the calibration and versioning discipline that keeps a live pricing system trustworthy

• 
Own the backlog and roadmap for portfolio management tooling, including exposure aggregation, concentration risk, and loss ratio trending

• 
Prioritise using the 5is framework (Inventory, Ideate, Incubate, Implementation, Iteration), scoring ideas against evidence, sponsorship, and sized benefit before they are resourced

• 
Write requirements and acceptance criteria that hold up against a data pipeline and a model, not just a user interface

• 
Partner with data science and engineers on the underlying models, understanding what drives a price change well enough to defend it to underwriting

• 
Define what good looks like for a new pricing factor or model version, and know when it needs data science or actuarial sign-off

• 
Sequence model and feature rollouts across regions and lines of business, from shadow mode through partial live to full automation, based on measured accuracy and error rates

• 
Use AI tools yourself to query rating engine output logs, run quick data explorations, and draft technical requirements against a schema

• 
Own stakeholder communication end to end, briefing leadership honestly about both what has shipped and what is still shaky

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken Danish and English is required.

Your Profile - A Great Match for RiskPoint:

For this position, we are looking for a structured, analytical, and pragmatic Product Owner who can sit between underwriters, actuaries, data scientists, and leadership, and speak each of their languages fluently.

You have 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally owning a data-heavy or model-backed product such as a pricing engine, risk scoring, or an analytics platform.

The role carries an underlying expectation: you use AI to build your own methodology, not just RiskPoint's products, and reach for it by default.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

• 
Comfort reading model outputs and asking sharp, informed questions about them, even without a data science background yourself

• 
Genuine fluency in agile ceremonies, and the judgement to know when process should flex to reality

• 
A sharp instinct for MVP scoping: what ships now, and what waits

• 
Practical, hands-on use of AI tools in your own workflow for requirements, data exploration, or documentation

• 
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to adjust your register to underwriters, actuaries, data scientists, and leadership

You are humble, and honest about uncertainty rather than dressing it up.

Although not required, RiskPoint would prefer candidates who have:

• Familiarity with how rating or pricing logic works in insurance or a comparable regulated, model-driven industry

Ready for the next step?

Technical Application Support Specialist - Use Your Developer Skills Close to the Business at RiskPoint

On behalf of RiskPoint, we are looking for a proactive and technically minded Technical Application Support Specialist to join their growing IT-team. If you are early in your developer career and prefer fixing a problem for good over fixing it again next Tuesday, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing specialist insurance solutions across multiple lines of business in close partnership with leading insurance companies. With more than 325 employees in 18 locations, RiskPoint combines deep underwriting expertise with in-house claims handling and strong business support.

As a Technical Application Support Specialist at RiskPoint, you will join the growing Application team within Group IT, part of the wider Finance and Operations department. The team currently consists of nine people, six based at the head office in Copenhagen and three working remotely. With daily stand-ups, the team collaborates closely and helps one another.

RiskPoint operates in an agile, collaborative environment with strong cross-border cooperation. Several systems are mid-migration at any given moment, and changes ship across Cyber, Directors and Officers (D&O), Transaction Risk, and Property in parallel. If that sounds chaotic, it is the fun kind. With a flat structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers real impact, ownership, and room to grow.

About the Position:

As a Technical Application Support Specialist at RiskPoint, you will take direct responsibility for the quality of application support, with a clear technical focus. You will maintain the stability and functionality of the internal applications and the integrations between them, and you will not just resolve incidents, but identify patterns in recurring issues and recommend improvements before they affect colleagues and daily operations.

The role is a great fit for someone early in their career as a developer who wants to use their skills close to the business. You will combine hands-on work with SQL, JSON, REST and SOAP integrations, and JavaScript or .NET with daily contact to the people who use the systems, as well as external vendors. As you grow, so will your responsibilities.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office. Most interactions take place online or over the phone, but in-person meetings are part of the job, including occasional travel to colleagues and stakeholders in other countries.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

• 
Provide technical support for internal applications and integrations, ensuring system stability and minimising operational disruptions

• 
Troubleshoot, analyse root causes, and proactively address recurring issues by looking into logs, data, and integration flows

• 
Query and analyse data with SQL to investigate issues and verify fixes

• 
Investigate and support integrations based on REST and SOAP services and JSON payloads

• 
Make small fixes, scripts, and improvements in JavaScript or .NET, with review from experienced colleagues

• 
Collaborate with analysts, developers, external vendors, and internal stakeholders to implement long-term solutions

• 
Reduce future support requests by improving processes, documentation, and guidance for colleagues

• 
Create and maintain internal documentation and training materials

• 
Manage and prioritise tickets in Jira, ensuring accountability and timely resolution

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken English is required, and other languages are an advantage.

Your Profile - A Great Match for RiskPoint:

For this position, we are looking for a structured, analytical, and service-minded Technical Application Support Specialist who takes ownership, balances multiple priorities, and drives tasks all the way to completion.

You have a relevant education, such as an AP Degree in Computer Science (datamatiker) or a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, and 1-3 years of experience as a developer, in application support, or in a similar technical role.

The role carries an underlying expectation: you use AI to build your own methodology, not just RiskPoint's products, and reach for it by default.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

• 
Hands-on experience with SQL, including querying and analysing data

• 
Working knowledge of JSON and of integrations based on REST and SOAP

• 
Development experience in JavaScript and/or .NET

• 
Experience managing tickets and working in agile delivery using Jira or similar tools

• 
A structured approach to troubleshooting and root cause analysis

• 
A service-oriented mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to build relationships

You are a strong team player who combines technical insight with clear communication, and you remain humble when building trust and driving progress across teams and vendors.

Although not required, RiskPoint would prefer candidates who have:

• 
An understanding of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, including common configuration tasks

• 
Knowledge of AL or C/AL

• 
Experience with other applications and technologies

**Your new position

**As Senior Scientist DMPK, you will drive DMPK science from early discovery through development, across a range of modalities. At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is growing, and we are looking for a Senior CMC Writer to support global regulatory submissions across our expanding portfolio.

Your primary focus will be documentation for global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), New Drug Applications (NDAs), and responses to health authority questions during assessment. Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will transform complex CMC information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers collaborating across early and late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management. As a senior colleague, you will independently drive writing activities, provide expert review and mentoring, and help improve documentation practices through AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities include:

• Independently authoring and coordinating review of Module 3 CTD sections and supporting source documents covering manufacturing processes and controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facilities

• Working with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners to resolve review comments and deliver approved documents within agreed timelines

• Serving as a go-to reviewer for scientific accuracy, document quality, consistency, and regulatory alignment, including verification of data against source documentation

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and maintaining the resulting updates across submissions and programs

• Supporting late stage initial filings, global roll outs, lifecycle maintenance, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed, while maintaining source document trackers and traceability

• Applying and refining CMC writing and response principles, templates, procedures, and style guides in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable GxP requirements

• Using AI, automation, and digital tools to identify documentation gaps and improve writing quality and efficiency, with critical evaluation of outputs and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Mentoring colleagues in regulatory writing and digital documentation practices, and contributing to process improvements and departmental initiatives

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or a related technical discipline. An advanced degree, relevant certification, or equivalent experience is preferred.

You bring at least six years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience in global regulatory submissions and pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing. Direct experience supporting IND, CTA, BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is expected

• Demonstrated expertise in authoring and reviewing complex CMC regulatory sections and/or supporting source documents, with the ability to independently manage writing activities and guide other authors

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory expectations across development stages and strong knowledge of CTD structure, GxP, and relevant documentation requirements

• Excellent written English, sound scientific judgment, and the ability to present complex information clearly, assess supporting data, and identify gaps and inconsistencies

• Practical experience using AI to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including effective prompting, critical assessment of outputs, and verification of scientific content

• Strong communication and influencing skills, enabling you to align cross-functional stakeholders, resolve differing perspectives, and mentor colleagues

• A proven record of ownership, effective prioritization, and timely delivery, combined with curiosity, continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that builds trust, welcomes feedback, and supports an inclusive work environment

**Application deadline: 30 November 2026

**The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**You will support in building the experimental foundation of a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, established to generate and validate innovative therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. As one of two Advanced Laboratory Technicians in In vivo Research, you will turn scientific questions into well-executed rodent studies and shape the team’s capabilities from the start. Your work helps bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline.

**What You Will Bring

**You are a trained laboratory technician, hold a relevant technical qualification, or bring equivalent practical experience.

• Strong hands-on experience in rodent research, including mouse and rat handling, dosing and sampling.

• Relevant training and authorisation for the animal procedures you will undertake, as applicable.

• A careful, organised approach to experimental work, documentation and data quality.

• The ability to work independently within agreed study plans and to coordinate with colleagues.

• Curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and an interest in learning new methods.

• Confidence in sharing observations, suggesting improvements and asking questions.

• The ability to communicate and document your work in English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Metabolic phenotyping, including food intake, body composition, glucose regulation or indirect calorimetry.

• Behavioural testing and neuroscience-related experimental methods.

• Rodent surgery and postoperative care.

• Tissue dissection, sample processing and ex vivo methods.

• In vitro assays supporting pharmacological or mechanistic studies.

• Establishing new laboratory methods or workflows.

You are not expected to bring experience in every technique. We welcome complementary profiles.

**What You Will Do

**Working closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians, you will contribute to studies that test new ideas and help set up how the team works in the lab. More specifically, you will:

• Plan, coordinate and perform mouse and rat pharmacology experiments, including dosing, observations, sampling and relevant physiological measurements.

• Perform metabolic phenotyping and contribute to behavioural studies, according to your expertise and training.

• Collect and process biological samples for ex vivo and laboratory analyses.

• Contribute to developing, optimising and troubleshooting experimental methods.

• Record, quality-check and organise experimental data, and flag observations that may affect interpretation or later studies.

• Bring practical expertise to study planning and to discussions of results.

• Help establish laboratory workflows, maintain equipment and coordinate materials and study activities, working to relevant procedures, animal welfare requirements and the principles of replacement, reduction and refinement.

Depending on your experience, you may also contribute to rodent surgery, specialised neuroscience methods or in vitro assays. Training will support the introduction of additional techniques.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research, part of Research & Development, working alongside scientists and laboratory colleagues with expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Scientific and technical colleagues plan experiments together, deliver them together and interpret the observations together, so your view counts at every step. The team is headed by Christoffer Clemmensen.

You will also work with animal facility staff and laboratory specialists across the organisation.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will help shape the experimental practices of a new team. Your technical judgement, observations and suggestions will be valued as part of the research process, and you will be trusted to work independently within agreed study plans.

Salary and Benefits**:** The Annual Base Salary ranges from 499,600.00 to 734,400.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn scientific questions into well-executed studies and help build a new team’s lab from the ground up, apply for the Advanced Laboratory Technician – In vivo Research role by 22 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as you can.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Would you like to help Whiteaway Group’s engineers spend less time working around tools and infrastructure, and more time building software?

We’re modernizing the platform behind software development at Whiteaway Group. We’re moving away from legacy systems, expanding our cloud platform and automating more of the work that slows teams down. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Platform Squad in Aarhus and help make it easier for our engineers to build, deploy and run software.

We treat our platform as a product, and our engineers are the people who use it every day. You’ll work directly with development teams to understand where they lose time, decide what to improve and see whether the changes make their work easier.

What you’ll help us achieve

Make it easier for teams to deploy and run their software. You’ll improve CI/CD pipelines and build self-service tools so teams can handle more routine tasks themselves. You’ll work with developers to find the steps that cause delays or require manual work, then help simplify or automate them.

Help us move away from legacy infrastructure while keeping the platform reliable. You’ll build and operate infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes, using Terraform to make changes repeatable. You’ll also improve monitoring and observability so teams can spot and diagnose problems, and help make secure access easier to manage.

Shape how we improve the developer experience. You’ll help the squad decide which platform improvements will make the biggest difference to development teams. We’re also exploring where AI could help the platform squad and the teams we support, and you’ll have room to test ideas where they solve a real problem.

What you’ll bring

You might be a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer or Site Reliability Engineer. You might also be a software engineer who has spent a significant part of your time building or operating cloud infrastructure.

We’re interested in what you’ve improved and how you went about it. Perhaps you’ve automated a deployment that used to require several manual steps, made a production issue easier to diagnose, or built a tool that helped other engineers work more independently.

We’re looking for hands-on experience in several areas of our stack: AWS, Kubernetes and Docker, Terraform, Linux and networking, and Git, GitHub and CI/CD. Experience with Node.js or Go is also relevant. If you’ve worked with GitOps, Argo CD, Datadog, Spacelift, Cloudflare or cloud security, that’s a plus.

Your team and how we work

You’ll join four Platform Engineers in a Tech organisation of around 45 people. Whiteaway Group is one of Scandinavia’s largest e-commerce companies for home appliances, with more than 300 employees. As we continue investing in the platform, you’ll have a say in what the squad builds and how we support development teams across the business.

We make time for learning and sharing knowledge through pair programming, hackathons and Improvement Mondays. You’ll also have access to learning resources and personal development opportunities.

We work primarily from our Aarhus office and offer one fixed day per week to work from home. We also offer a pension scheme, a lunch scheme, an on-site gym and free parking.

Interested?

Send us your application and CV via our careers site. We’d love to hear about a platform, tool or workflow you’ve improved: what problem you tackled, what you changed and what difference it made.

We review applications and hold interviews on a rolling basis, and we’ll hire as soon as we find the right person.
